notes: §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR6: 'File-name-2 and file-name-3 must be described in a file description entry, not in a sort-merge file description entry, in the Data Division.' SortBindFile maps the USING and GIVING lists through SortMapIoFiles, which resolves each name through StatementValidation.ResolveFile and refuses a file whose model IsSortMerge with COBOL1757 at every edition including 85; the report-file exclusion 2023 adds also holds at 85 by §1985:XIII.3.3.3 SR3, through ScreenReportFileReference (COBOL2577). Probes at --std 85: (b) another SD in USING (USING IN1 SW2), in GIVING (GIVING SW2, and GIVING OUT1 SW2 as the second GIVING file), and the SORT's own SD in GIVING: each COBOL1757; a report FD in USING and in GIVING: COBOL2577; (e) SORT DESCENDING USING two sequential files GIVING a relative and a sequential file compiles, and both hold CCCC BBBB AAAA on read-back. The witness names the SORT's own SD as file-name-2.

next.reason: 1985: "must be described in a file description entry, not in a sort-merge file description entry"; 2023: "shall be described in a file description entry that is not for a report file and is not a sort-merge file description entry". Both keep file-name-2/3 in an FD and not an SD, but 2023 also refuses an FD for a report file, which the 1985 rule allowed.
